inputs.prompt: <Video 1> <Picture 1> <Picture 2> <Picture 3> At the open doorway of a modest Chinese apartment in soft early morning light, an open entrance door with a plain frame, a narrow console table just inside the door, and beyond it the same small kitchen with a sink and counter, a window with a pale curtain and shelves with bowls, the door and the table and the kitchen beyond arranged as in the reference <Picture 3>. A Chinese woman in her late fifties with the same face exactly matching the reference portrait <Picture 1>, short dark hair with silver streaks, wearing a plain dove-grey knit cardigan. An elderly Chinese woman aged eighty with the same face exactly matching the reference portrait <Picture 2>, short silver-grey hair, thin wire-framed glasses, wearing a dark navy knit cardigan.
